record.edic_text:
2582 Kandake {kan-dak'-ay}

of foreign origin;; n pr f

AV - Candace 1; 1

Candace = "prince of servants"
1) a queen of Ethiopia mentioned in Acts 8:27. (A.D. 38) The name was
   not a proper name of an individual, but that of a dynasty of
   Ethiopian queens.
